Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly placed Warner Bros. Nashville under Warner Bros. Entertainment and pursued Warner Bros. Discovery as the owner, conflating the film/TV company with the separate music company. The correct parent of Warner Bros. Nashville is Warner Music Group. This misidentification of the corporate parent could lead to the wrong ownership answer.
